mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates weakening labor demand and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 6.0%, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) amplify demand signals, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns through expanded equity valuation growth.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (R-squared < 0.05 in regression) or returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), elevated discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during tightening periods, or Rank IC ≥ 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 97.5 (2017=100 index) signals robust supply-side expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during expansion, or Rank IC ≥ 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 5.0% (UNRATE < 5.0%) and payrolls surge above 132,151 ( recent value), this dual labor market improvement signals strong demand, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (R-squared < 0.05) or returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicates tight labor markets, fostering robust economic activity and positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns through expanded corporate investment.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC ≥ 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (high HOUST and GDPC1), S&P 500 forward returns remain positive over 20 days as market anticipates limited growth and stable valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle phases, or Rank IC ≥ 0.03 over any 1-year window.
